decision: Owner-approved replacement of the high-times-1.08 bracket with at least 20% demand headroom and early-electrification coverage
biomass_planning_rule: Deduct the full 12 PJ at the highest observed B/A biomass electricity yield; actual new-cell deductions must be rechecked before acceptance
stress_interpolation: Linear in absolute source TWh between the named knots; 2027 and 2029 are authored demand-shape points, not additional investment solves
anchor_rule: Keep the common 2025 anchor; apply 20% headroom from the first future decision year, 2027. Interpolate 2026 delivered demand between the anchor and the adjusted 2027 stress point
acceptance: At least 20% quantity headroom after the actual delivery and biomass adjustments at every decision year from 2027 through 2060
Whole-history demand-fit and system checks for every baseline scenario and its 20%-higher future grid-demand stress; preserve the 2025 anchor
All four cap schedules on the stress path, with their absolute caps recalculated for its demand; high demand and clean supply must be available together
An upper-demand clean chain passes before the remaining production grid is released; count it within the planned 40 chains
Annual interpolation and pre-2030 supply require author acceptance; quantity coverage is not proof of buildable fleets or a feasible fixed history blend
